title: City College returned federal student aid late in 11 of 25 tested cases

beats.text: At City College, withdrawal decisions started the clock for returning federal student aid.

visual.sub: Withdrawal decisions were late in 23 of 25 calculations

beats.text: Auditors tested 25 of the college’s 202 return calculations.
In 23 cases, the withdrawal decision missed the deadline.
The deadline to send money back was 45 days from the determination.

visual.kicker: Eleven of those tested returns missed the federal deadline

beats.text: In 11 of the same 25 cases, the money went back late.
The district did return the required funds. Auditors questioned no costs.

visual.kicker: Eleven of those tested returns missed the federal deadline

beats.text: A separate deadline applied to reporting when a grant was disbursed.

visual.kicker: A separate 15-day reporting deadline was missed across two years

beats.text: Seven of forty files missed that window in the first year.
The next audit found five late reports among forty files.
The next two audits closed the recommendations in different years.

visual.kicker: Two recommendations closed in different reports

beats.text: The college reported moving its return calculations into its shared financial-aid system.

visual.kicker: Two recommendations closed in different reports
